title: Paid in Full
description: Glover Mallory, the blacksmith of Raven Rock and Delvin Mallory's brother, asks the player to recover his stolen improved bonemold formula from Esmond Tyne, who fled to Castle Karstaag Caverns. After returning the formula, the player can discover Glover's Letter in his basement revealing he is Sapphire's real father, and optionally tell her the truth in Riften.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Raven Rock and a member of the Thieves Guild.
Esmond Tyne stole my improved bonemold formula and fled toward Castle Karstaag Caverns to fence goods to the rieklings.
There is a shadowmark by the front door of my house.

RETURN_FORMULA: The player returned my bonemold formula. I gave them the key to my house and basement as a reward.
DISCOVER_LETTER: The player found my letter in the basement revealing I am Sapphire's real father.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player returned my bonemold formula. I paid them with the key to my house and basement, telling them to help themselves to whatever they find inside.
Esmond Tyne was a bloody fool who got what he deserved for ignoring my warnings about the rieklings at Castle Karstaag.
My basement holds years of accumulated Thieves Guild wealth, including a complete set of Blackguard's Armor.
The letter hidden in my basement reveals that Sapphire is my daughter—a truth I fled to Solstheim because I couldn't bear to tell her in person.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.

REVEAL_TRUTH: The player told me that Glover Mallory is my real father. I gave them my exquisite sapphire as thanks.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I remain in Riften, unaware that Glover Mallory is my real father.
If brought Glover's letter revealing the truth about my parentage, I would give my exquisite sapphire as thanks for finally knowing.

beats.comment: Player notices the shadowmark and learns about the stolen bonemold formula from Glover.
Player recovers the bonemold formula from Esmond Tyne's corpse in Castle Karstaag Caverns.
Player returns the bonemold formula to Glover and receives the key to his house and basement.
Player finds Glover's Letter in the basement revealing he is Sapphire's real father.
Player reveals to Sapphire in Riften that Glover Mallory is her real father.
